review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, nurturing existing client relationships, and expanding STS’s presence in the cybersecurity and advanced technology markets. The role also involves maintaining accurate sales reporting, forecasting, and pipeline management to support informed decision-making. Qualifications Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, relationship management, and deal negotiation.
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt.
Ability to work on-site in Cairo, manage multiple priorities, and travel to client locations or regional events as needed.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, relationship management, and deal negotiation. Proficiency in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.
